points: Share the experience or situation that sparked your question
Explain why this topic matters to you personally
Set the tone for thoughtful, open discussion
Avoid yes/no questions — invite stories and opinions
Use "how" or "what" to encourage deeper responses
Leave room for unexpected perspectives
Acknowledge there may be no single right answer
Be open to answers that challenge your assumptions
Engage respectfully with diverse opinions
State exactly what you're trying to achieve
Describe what's happening vs. what you expected
Include relevant versions, platforms, or configurations
List solutions you've already attempted
Explain why they didn't work
Include any error messages or unexpected behavior
Add code snippets, logs, or screenshots if helpful
Remove sensitive data but keep the context
Focus on the specific issue, not your entire setup
Avoid jargon or explain technical terms
Frame your question for a general audience
Make it interesting to people from different backgrounds
Briefly explain why you're asking
Give enough background for meaningful answers
Be clear about what kind of answer would help
Encourage both practical and creative responses
Be open to answers from unexpected angles
Appreciate different levels of expertise
